meta.title: CBIAT | Costa Rican Chamber of Blockchain, AI & Emerging Technologies
meta.description: CBIAT brings together industry, academia, government and society to strengthen Costa Rica's technology ecosystem.

hero.eyebrow: Costa Rican Chamber of Blockchain, Artificial Intelligence & Emerging Technologies
hero.title: Technology for a stronger Costa Rica.
hero.body: We bring together the private sector, academia, government and society to strengthen Costa Rica's technology ecosystem and advance ethical, responsible, competitive and sustainable adoption.

statement.text: We organize the public conversation, reduce market fragmentation, raise standards and turn dispersed innovation into an institutional agenda with national impact.

work.title: A multisector platform for action.
work.intro: CBIAT connects technical knowledge, sector representation and cooperation to turn technology challenges into concrete opportunities for Costa Rica.

items.title: Public policy and regulation
items.body: We participate in public consultations, technical roundtables, regulatory processes and legislative initiatives, contributing technical criteria and institutional support.

items.title: Ecosystem and competitiveness
items.body: We connect companies, startups, academia, investors and technology providers to accelerate responsible adoption and create opportunities.

items.title: Education, research and standards
items.body: We promote training, observatories, studies, whitepapers, good practices, governance frameworks and voluntary standards.

items.title: Innovation and internationalization
items.body: We advance pilots, sandboxes, knowledge transfer, strategic alliances and national and international technical cooperation.

agenda.title: Priorities for a stronger technology ecosystem.

items.title: AI and governance
items.body: Advance the safe, ethical and responsible adoption of artificial intelligence in Costa Rica.

items.title: Blockchain, tokenization and digital assets
items.body: Promote use cases with economic and social impact.

items.title: Digital identity and sovereignty
items.body: Promote secure, inclusive and citizen-centered digital identity solutions.

items.title: Innovation and modernization of government
items.body: Support public-sector digital transformation through technology and innovation.

items.title: Talent and technology competitiveness
items.body: Strengthen human talent and national capabilities for a competitive digital economy.

purpose.title: Technical rigor. Independence. Transparency. Responsible governance.
purpose.body: CBIAT is a private, technical, multisector and nonprofit chamber. It represents, connects and strengthens Costa Rica's emerging-technology ecosystem.

principles.title: Technical rigor
principles.body: Decisions based on evidence, specialized knowledge and international best practices.

principles.title: Independence
principles.body: Autonomous action guided by the broader interests of the ecosystem and the country.

principles.title: Responsible governance
principles.body: Inclusive, plural dialogue with a long-term perspective.

participation.title: From conversation to action.
participation.intro: The Chamber creates concrete spaces to produce knowledge, build proposals and execute initiatives with impact.

knowledge.title: Better decisions require better information.
knowledge.body: CBIAT's knowledge center will bring together studies, whitepapers, observatories, technical criteria and institutional positions to support the sector and decision-makers.

membership.title: Help shape Costa Rica's technology environment.
membership.body: Being part of CBIAT means access to advocacy spaces, regulatory and sector intelligence, specialized knowledge, cooperation and institutional positioning.

pillars.title: Advocacy and representation
pillars.body: Take part in the sector conversation and contribute to a competitive and responsible environment for innovation.

pillars.title: Knowledge and education
pillars.body: Access regulatory and market intelligence, studies, analysis, learning and global best practices.

pillars.title: Connections and opportunities
pillars.body: Join a multisector network and create alliances, projects and high-impact opportunities.
